notes.title: First Time in Rome - Now Available!
notes.content:
We hope you’re ready to explore the Capital of the World, because [b]First Time in Rome[/b], is now out on Steam! Join Kate and Nicole Robinson on the tour of their lives, where they’ll meet new people, make new memories, and unveil the hidden beauty of Rome. See the many sights and sounds of the Eternal City.

Make sure you check First Time in Rome while it's still on 20% sale!
